33124.a:
1. **Kirish:** SSH yo'q — cloud serial console (AWS EC2 Serial Console, GCP serial port) yoki IPMI/iLO.
2. **GRUB menyusi:** "Advanced options" -> oldingi kernel. Menyu ko'rinmasa: `Shift`/`Esc` (BIOS/UEFI), yoki `GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE=menu`.
3. **Ekranda nima?**
   - `Kernel panic - not syncing: VFS: Unable to mount root fs` — initramfs'da storage driver yo'q (nvme, virtio) yoki noto'g'ri `root=`.
   - `dracut-initqueue timeout` / emergency shell — root UUID/LVM topilmadi.
   - emergency mode — fstab muammosi.
4. **Tuzatish (eski kernel bilan boot qilgach):**
```
uname -r
ls /boot ; lsinitrd /boot/initramfs-<ver>.img | grep nvme      # RHEL
lsinitramfs /boot/initrd.img-<ver> | grep nvme                  # Ubuntu
sudo dracut -f --kver <ver>          # / update-initramfs -u -k <ver>
sudo dkms status                     # 3rd-party modul (NVIDIA, ZFS, VPN) yangi kernelga build bo'lmagan
sudo grub2-set-default 1 ; sudo grubby --default-kernel   # RHEL
sudo grub-set-default "1>2" && sudo update-grub           # Ubuntu (GRUB_DEFAULT=saved)
```
5. **Konsol ham yo'q bo'lsa (cloud):** root volume'ni boshqa (rescue) VM'ga ulash -> `chroot` -> initramfs/grub tuzatish -> qaytarish.

Prevention: kernel yangilashni canary (1-5% host) bilan, reboot'dan keyin avtomatik health check, `installonly_limit=3` (eski kernellar saqlansin), immutable image'lar (yangi AMI bilan almashtirish).

33125.a:
```
# emergency shell'da
journalctl -xb | grep -iE "fail|timed out|dependency"
#  Timed out waiting for device dev-disk-by\x2duuid-...device
#  Dependency failed for /data
systemctl --failed
mount -o remount,rw /
vi /etc/fstab            # qatorni izohga ol yoki UUID'ni tuzat; ma'lumot diskiga nofail qo'sh
blkid                    # haqiqiy UUID'lar
systemctl daemon-reload
mount -a                 # xatosiz o'tsin
fsck -y /dev/sdb1        # FS xatosi bo'lsa (UMOUNT holatda!)
reboot
```
Root paroli yo'q / root bloklangan bo'lsa: GRUB'da `e` -> `linux` qatoriga `rd.break` (RHEL) yoki `init=/bin/bash` -> `mount -o remount,rw /sysroot` -> `chroot /sysroot` -> tuzat (SELinux bo'lsa `touch /.autorelabel`).
Cloud'da konsol bo'lmasa: diskni rescue VM'ga ulab fstab'ni tuzat.

Prevention: ma'lumot disklariga **`nofail`** (va `x-systemd.device-timeout=10s`), fstab o'zgartirgandan keyin har doim `mount -a` + `findmnt --verify`.

33126.a:
```
dmesg -T | grep -iE "EXT4-fs error|I/O error|remount|journal|XFS.*(error|shutdown)"
#  EXT4-fs error (device sda1): ... Remounting filesystem read-only
#  blk_update_request: I/O error, dev sda, sector ...
mount | grep " / "            # (ro,...)
tune2fs -l /dev/sda1 | grep -i "state\|errors"
smartctl -a /dev/sda          # yoki cloud volume status
```
Tartib:
1. Ilovani to'xtat / trafikni boshqa node'ga o'tkaz.
2. Iloji boricha ma'lumotni nusxala (ro holatda o'qish mumkin) / snapshot.
3. Disk muammosi bo'lsa — diskni almashtir; bo'lmasa:
```
umount /data ; fsck.ext4 -f /dev/sdb1        # ext4
xfs_repair /dev/sdb1                          # XFS (avval -n dry-run)
```
Root FS bo'lsa — rescue mode / boshqa VM orqali fsck.
4. `mount -o remount,rw` faqat sabab tushunilgan va disk sog'lom bo'lsa.

Boshqa sabablar: cloud volume ajralib qolgan (EBS detach/IO stall), thin pool to'lgan, NFS server ro export, SAN/iSCSI uzilishi. Docker/K8s'da `readOnlyRootFilesystem` — bu sozlama, xato emas.

33127.a:
```
df -h                         # qotadi -> df -hl (faqat lokal) yoki timeout 3 df
mount -t nfs,nfs4
cat /proc/self/mountstats | less
nfsstat -c ; rpcinfo -p nfs-server
showmount -e nfs-server
ps -eo stat,pid,wchan:30,cmd | grep "^D"     # nfs_wait / rpc_wait
ping nfs-server ; nc -zv nfs-server 2049
```
Majburiy ajratish:
```
umount -f /mnt/nfs            # force (NFS uchun)
umount -l /mnt/nfs            # lazy — namespace'dan ajratadi, jarayonlar osilgancha qoladi
```
Mount opsiyalari:
- `hard` (default, to'g'ri) — ma'lumot butunligi; `soft` — timeout bo'lsa ilovaga xato qaytaradi (yozishda korrupsiya xavfi, faqat read-only uchun).
- `timeo=600,retrans=2`, `_netdev` (tarmoqdan keyin mount), `nofail`, `x-systemd.automount` (kerak bo'lganda mount).
Architect fikri: NFS — single point of failure; ko'p ilovalar uchun object storage (S3) yoki managed fayl xizmati (EFS) va monitoring (`node_nfs_*`, mount probe).

33128.a:
```
df -i
# qaysi katalogda fayl ko'p (du --inodes, coreutils 8.22+)
sudo du --inodes -x / 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -15
# yoki
sudo find / -xdev -type d -size +1M 2>/dev/null       # katta katalog (ko'p yozuv)
for d in /var/*; do echo "$(sudo find $d -xdev | wc -l) $d"; done | sort -n
```
Tozalash (millionlab faylda `rm *` = "Argument list too long"):
```
find /var/lib/php/sessions -type f -mmin +1440 -delete
find /tmp/cache -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1000 rm -f
rsync -a --delete /empty/ /huge_dir/        # juda katta katalogni tez bo'shatish
```
Tipik sabablar: cron xatolari tufayli `/var/spool/postfix` / `mail` to'lgan, sessionlar tozalanmaydi, ilova cache TTL'siz, dangling docker image qatlamlari, `/var/lib/kubelet`.
Uzoq muddat: tozalash job + monitoring (inode alert), kerak bo'lsa yangi FS ko'proq inode bilan (`mkfs.ext4 -i 4096`) yoki XFS (dinamik inode).

33129.a:
```
curl -o /dev/null -s -w "dns %{time_namelookup} connect %{time_connect} tls %{time_appconnect} ttfb %{time_starttransfer}\n" https://api.x.com
# dns 5.004 ...  -> DNS
for i in $(seq 20); do /usr/bin/time -f %e getent hosts api.x.com >/dev/null; done
cat /etc/resolv.conf
tcpdump -i any -nn udp port 53
```
DNS sabablari:
- Birinchi `nameserver` ishlamaydi -> `timeout:5` dan keyin ikkinchisiga o'tadi.
- glibc A va AAAA so'rovlarini bitta socket'dan parallel yuboradi; conntrack race (ayniqsa K8s/Docker NAT) bittasini tashlaydi -> 5s kutish. Yechim: `options single-request-reopen` yoki `use-vc`, NodeLocal DNSCache.
- K8s `ndots:5` — tashqi domen uchun 4-5 ta keraksiz so'rov (search domenlar).
- IPv6 AAAA so'rovi javobsiz.

Boshqa "dumaloq" raqamlar: **1s/3s** — TCP SYN retransmit (paket yo'qolgan/backlog to'la, `nstat ListenDrops`), **200ms/40ms** — Nagle + delayed ACK, **30s/60s** — LB/proxy idle timeout.

33130.a:
```
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/<path>/cpu.max          # "200000 100000" = 2 CPU
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/<path>/cpu.stat
#  nr_periods 120000
#  nr_throttled 45000        # 37% davrlarda to'xtatilgan!
#  throttled_usec 980000000
```
PromQL:
```
rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])
```
Nega: limit 2 CPU, ilovada 16 thread (Go GOMAXPROCS = host core soni 16!) -> 100ms davrda 200ms CPU kvotasi 12.5ms ichida tugaydi -> 87ms kutish.
Yechimlar:
- Go: `GOMAXPROCS` = limit (Go 1.25+ cgroup'ni o'zi hisobga oladi; eskisida `automaxprocs`). Java: `-XX:ActiveProcessorCount`.
- Latency-sezgir servisga CPU **limit** qo'ymaslik (faqat request) — ko'p jamoalarda amaliyot.
- Limitni oshirish yoki thread sonini kamaytirish.
Ko'r-ko'rona "CPU 40%, hammasi joyida" degan xulosa — klassik xato.

33131.a:
```
dmesg -T | grep conntrack
cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count
cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
conntrack -S                                  # drop, insert_failed, early_drop
conntrack -L -o extended | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn   # holatlar
```
Tuzatish:
```
# /etc/sysctl.d/90-conntrack.conf
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 1048576
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established = 3600   # default 5 kun!
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_time_wait = 30
# hash jadval (modul parametri): echo 262144 > /sys/module/nf_conntrack/parameters/hashsize
```
- Har yozuv ~300 bayt RAM — 1M ≈ 300MB.
- Yuqori RPS'li ichki trafikni kuzatmaslik: `iptables -t raw -A PREROUTING -p udp --dport 53 -j NOTRACK` (ehtiyot bilan).
- Root cause: qisqa ulanishlar (keep-alive yo'q), DNS UDP bo'roni, DDoS/SYN flood. Monitoring: `node_nf_conntrack_entries / node_nf_conntrack_entries_limit > 0.8`.

33132.a:
```
grep -E "MemTotal|MemAvailable|AnonPages|Shmem|Slab|SReclaimable|SUnreclaim|PageTables|HugePages_Total|Hugetlb|KernelStack|VmallocUsed" /proc/meminfo
sudo slabtop -o -s c | head -20         # eng katta slab cache'lar
df -h -t tmpfs                           # /dev/shm, /run katta?
ipcs -m                                  # SysV shared memory
lsof +L1 | grep -i tmpfs
cat /proc/sys/vm/nr_hugepages
```
Talqin:
- `Shmem` katta — tmpfs/`/dev/shm` ga yozilgan fayllar (ular RAM!), Postgres shared_buffers, IPC.
- `SReclaimable` (dentry) katta — normal, bosimda bo'shaydi (millionlab fayl stat qilinganda o'sadi).
- `SUnreclaim` doimiy o'sadi — kernel/driver leak (`kmalloc-*` qaysi biri o'sayotganiga qara) -> kernel yangilash.
- `HugePages_Total` — oldindan band qilingan, hech kim ishlatmasa ham.
- `PageTables` katta — juda ko'p jarayon/katta xotira mapping.
`AnonPages + Shmem + Slab + PageTables + ... ≈ used` — summani tekshirib, "yo'qolgan" xotirani top.

33133.a:
```
ps -eLf | wc -l                                   # jami thread
ps -eo user= | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # user bo'yicha
ps -eo stat,ppid,pid,cmd | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/'         # zombie + ota PID
ulimit -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max
systemctl show app -p TasksMax,TasksCurrent
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/<path>/pids.max /sys/fs/cgroup/<path>/pids.current
```
Yechim:
- Thread leak (Java thread pool cheksiz, Go goroutine emas — OS thread; cgo/blocking syscall'lar) — ilovani tuzat.
- Zombie: ota jarayonni tuzat (SIGCHLD/wait). Tez: otasini restart -> zombie'lar init (PID 1) ga o'tib tozalanadi. Zombie'ni `kill -9` qilib bo'lmaydi.
- Konteynerda PID 1 ilova (shell) zombie yig'maydi — `tini` / `docker run --init`.
- Limit oshirish (`TasksMax=`, `LimitNPROC=`) faqat sabab tushunilgandan keyin; limit — fork-bomb himoyasi.

33134.a:
```
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range        # 32768 60999 (~28k)
ss -tan state time-wait | wc -l
ss -tan state time-wait '( dport = :5432 )' | wc -l   # bitta upstream'ga
nstat -az | grep -i TcpExtTW
```
Hisob: 28k port / 60s TIME_WAIT ≈ bitta upstream'ga ~470 yangi ulanish/s maksimum.
Yechimlar (ustuvorlik tartibida):
1. **Ulanishlarni qayta ishlat**: HTTP keep-alive (Go: `resp.Body`ni o'qib yopish, `MaxIdleConnsPerHost` oshirish — default 2!), DB pool (pgbouncer).
2. `net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1` (chiquvchi uchun xavfsiz).
3. `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535`.
4. Upstream'ni bir nechta IP orqasiga qo'yish.
`tcp_tw_recycle` — kernel 4.12 dan olib tashlangan, NAT ortidagi client'larni buzardi; interview'da "yoqamiz" demang.

33135.a:
```
ss -s ; ss -tan state syn-recv | wc -l
nstat -az | grep -iE "SyncookiesSent|ListenOverflows|ListenDrops"
tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -c 1000 'tcp[tcpflags] & tcp-syn != 0' | awk '{print $3}' | cut -d. -f1-4 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
iftop -i eth0 / nload
awk '{print $1}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head    # L7
```
Host chora:
```
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=65536
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries=2
# per-IP yangi ulanish limiti
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --syn --dport 443 -m hashlimit --hashlimit-name syn \
  --hashlimit-mode srcip --hashlimit-above 50/sec -j DROP
# nftables set bilan IP bloklash; ipset — minglab IP uchun samarali
```
L7 (HTTP flood): nginx `limit_req`, CDN/WAF challenge, kesh.
Senior: volumetric hujum (Gbps) NIC'ni to'ldiradi — host'da hech narsa yordam bermaydi; anycast CDN/scrubbing kerak. Oldindan: runbook, provider bilan kontakt, autoscaling chegarasi (hisob portlamasin).

33136.a:
```
sudo iptables-save > /root/fw.backup
# 5 daqiqadan keyin avtomatik rollback (tasdiqlasang — bekor qil)
echo "iptables-restore < /root/fw.backup" | sudo at now + 5 minutes
sudo iptables -I INPUT 1 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
sudo iptables -I INPUT 2 -p tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEPT
sudo iptables -P INPUT DROP
# yangi SSH sessiyani OCHIB ko'r -> ishlasa:
sudo atrm $(atq | awk '{print $1}')
sudo iptables-save | sudo tee /etc/iptables/rules.v4     # doimiy (iptables-persistent)
```
- `iptables-apply` — o'zi tasdiq so'raydi, javob bo'lmasa qaytaradi.
- firewalld: `firewall-cmd --add-rich-rule=... --timeout=300` (runtime, vaqtinchalik).
- ufw: `ufw allow OpenSSH` — `ufw enable` dan **oldin**.
- `-P INPUT DROP` + `iptables -F` = to'liq blok (policy qoladi, qoidalar o'chadi) — klassik tuzoq.
Chiqib ketgan bo'lsang: cloud serial console, security group orqali emas (u host firewall'ga ta'sir qilmaydi), yoki reboot (agar qoidalar saqlanmagan bo'lsa).

33137.a:
```
systemctl status app
#  Active: activating (auto-restart) (Result: exit-code) ... status=1/FAILURE
#  restart counter is at 37
journalctl -u app -b -o short-precise | grep -m5 -iE "error|fatal|panic"     # BIRINCHI xato
journalctl -u app -n 200 --no-pager
systemctl show app -p NRestarts,ExecMainStatus,ExecMainCode,Result
coredumpctl list app ; coredumpctl info <PID> ; coredumpctl gdb <PID>
```
Exit kodlarini o'qish:
| Status | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| 1 / 2 | ilova xatosi (config, flag, ulanib bo'lmadi) |
| 203/EXEC | binary yo'q, `+x` yo'q, noto'g'ri arxitektura, shebang |
| 217/USER, 200/CHDIR, 226/NAMESPACE | unit sozlamasi (user, katalog, ProtectSystem yo'li yo'q) |
| signal=KILL, Result=oom-kill | MemoryMax / OOM |
| signal=SEGV (139), ABRT (134) | crash — coredump |

Qo'lda ishga tushirish:
```
sudo systemd-run --uid=app --pty -p EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env /opt/app/bin/api
```
Tez-tez sabablar: DB/dependency hali tayyor emas (ilovada retry yo'q), port band (`ss -tlnp`), secret/sertifikat yo'q yoki muddati o'tgan, migration yiqilgan. Crash-loop paytida log bo'roni journald'ni bosmasin — `StartLimitBurst`.

33138.a:
```
journalctl --list-boots        # faqat 0 bo'lsa — persistent emas
ls /var/log/journal            # yo'q bo'lsa:
sudo mkdir -p /var/log/journal && sudo systemd-tmpfiles --create --prefix /var/log/journal
sudo systemctl restart systemd-journald
journalctl -u systemd-journald | grep -i suppressed
timedatectl ; chronyc tracking
journalctl -o short-iso-precise    # aniq vaqt + TZ
journalctl --utc
```
- Kernel panic paytidagi oxirgi xabarlar diskka yetib bormaydi — `netconsole`, `kdump` (crash dump), serial console logi yoki pstore (`/sys/fs/pstore`).
- Hard reset oldidan: `journalctl -b -1 -e` — oldingi boot oxiri.
- Markaziy log tizimida vaqt: agentning ingestion vaqti emas, log ichidagi timestamp ishlatilsin; hamma joyda UTC + ISO 8601.

33139.a:
```
journalctl -u ssh | grep -iE "drop|MaxStartups|beyond|exceeded"
#  drop connection #10 from [10.0.0.9]:51234 on [..]:22 past MaxStartups
ssh -vvv host   # client: "Connection reset by peer" qaysi bosqichda
```
Sabab va yechim:
- Ansible `forks=50` -> bir vaqtda 50 ulanish bitta bastion'ga -> `MaxStartups 10:30:100` tasodifiy drop. sshd: `MaxStartups 100:30:200`, yoki forks kamaytir.
- ControlMaster bitta TCP ichida ko'p sessiya -> `MaxSessions 10` (default) yetmaydi.
- Uzoq jim buyruq (DB migration 10 daqiqa output'siz) -> NAT/LB idle timeout. Client: `ServerAliveInterval 30`; server: `ClientAliveInterval 60`. Uzoq ishni `async` (Ansible) yoki `systemd-run` bilan fonda.
- `ssh_exchange_identification: read: Connection reset` — `/etc/hosts.deny`, fail2ban bloklagan (CI runner IP!), MaxStartups.
- "Broken pipe" — keepalive yo'q va ulanish o'lgan.

33140.a:
**Xodim ketdi (statik kalitlar bilan):**
```
# qaysi serverlarda kaliti bor
ansible all -b -m shell -a "grep -l 'mansur@laptop' /home/*/.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null"
# olib tashlash — authorized_key modul (state: absent) bilan, qo'lda emas
```
Shuningdek: umumiy `deploy` kaliti / bastion kaliti unga ma'lum bo'lsa — rotatsiya; cloud IAM, VPN, Vault token'lari; sessiyalarni uzish (`pkill -u`), `last`/audit bilan oxirgi faollikni tekshir.

**Yaxshi dizayn:**
- SSH CA + qisqa TTL (8-24 soat) sertifikatlar SSO orqali -> offboarding = IdP'da o'chirish.
- `AuthorizedKeysCommand` — kalitlarni markaziy joydan (LDAP/IdP) olish.
- Shaxsiy kalitlar, umumiy `root` kaliti yo'q.
- Host key: `HostCertificate` (CA imzolagan) — known_hosts ogohlantirishlari yo'qoladi; rotatsiyada `UpdateHostKeys yes` client'larga yangisini o'rgatadi.
- KRL (`RevokedKeys`) — buzilgan kalit/sertifikatni darhol bekor qilish.

33141.a:
```
dig +short api.x.com @ns1.provider.com     # authoritative — yangi IP?
dig api.x.com @8.8.8.8 +noall +answer      # qolgan TTL ko'rinadi
dig api.x.com @1.1.1.1
resolvectl flush-caches ; resolvectl statistics
```
Kesh qatlamlari:
1. Authoritative'dagi TTL (masalan 3600) — eski yozuvni resolver'lar shuncha saqlaydi.
2. Rekursiv resolver (ISP, 8.8.8.8, korporativ).
3. OS (systemd-resolved, nscd), brauzer.
4. Ilova: Java (JVM ba'zan cheksiz keshlaydi, security manager bilan), connection pool'lar — **eski TCP ulanishlar** DNS o'zgarishini umuman ko'rmaydi!

Reja: T-2 kun TTL -> 60s; cutover; eski endpoint'ni kamida eski TTL + zaxira vaqt ishlatib tur (yoki eski IP'da proxy -> yangi); ilovada uzoq yashovchi ulanishlarga max lifetime (`SetConnMaxLifetime`).
Negativ kesh: yozuv yo'q paytida so'ralgan bo'lsa — SOA'dagi minimum TTL bo'yicha `NXDOMAIN` keshlanadi.

33143.a:
```
apt list --upgradable ; sudo unattended-upgrade --dry-run -d
sudo dnf updateinfo list security ; sudo dnf upgrade --security
needrestart -r l                     # qaysi servislar eski kutubxona bilan ishlayapti
dnf needs-restarting -r              # reboot kerakmi
ls /var/run/reboot-required          # Ubuntu

```
Jarayon:
1. **Ko'rinish:** OS/paket inventari, CVE skaner (Trivy, OpenSCAP, Qualys, AWS Inspector), `needrestart`.
2. **Siyosat:** critical/internetga ochiq — tezkor; boshqalar — oylik oyna.
3. **Rollout:** dev -> staging -> prod 5% -> 25% -> 100%, har to'lqindan keyin SLO/metrika tekshiruvi, avtomatik to'xtash.
4. **Reboot:** LB'dan chiqarish/drain -> reboot -> health -> qaytarish (K8s: kured; serverlar: Ansible `serial`). Kernel livepatch reboot'ni kechiktiradi, bekor qilmaydi.
5. **Yangilanish keyin servis restart'i** — kutubxona (openssl, glibc) yangilangani bilan ishlab turgan jarayon eski versiyani xotirada ushlaydi.
Immutable yondashuv: Packer bilan yangi AMI/image -> rolling replace. Snowflake server'lar yo'q.

33144.a:
Komponentlar:
| Qatlam | Qanday tiklanadi |
|---|---|
| Infra | Terraform/Ansible — yangi region'da `apply` (state ham zaxirada!) |
| Server config | IaC, golden image |
| Ma'lumot | DB cross-region replika yoki backup + WAL (PITR), object storage replication |
| Secret'lar | Vault/KMS replication; break-glass kalitlar alohida joyda |
| DNS/Traffic | past TTL, health-check failover (Route53 failover) |
| Odamlar | runbook, kim qaror qiladi, kontaktlar, kommunikatsiya |

Strategiyalar (narx vs RTO): backup & restore (soatlar/kunlar) -> pilot light -> warm standby -> multi-site active-active (daqiqalar, qimmat, consistency murakkab).
Senior nuqtalar:
- Bog'liqliklar aylanasi: tiklash uchun kerak bo'lgan vosita (CI, Vault, artifact registry) o'sha yo'qolgan region'da bo'lmasin.
- Har chorak DR drill — haqiqiy RTO o'lchanadi, runbook yangilanadi.
- Backup'lar alohida account/region'da, immutable (ransomware).

33145.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Snowflake server — qo'lda, hujjatsiz sozlangan, takrorlab bo'lmaydigan yagona server. Config drift — kodda (Ansible/Terraform) yozilgan kutilgan holat bilan serverning haqiqiy holati orasidagi farq. Oldini olish: barcha o'zgarish faqat kod va PR orqali, drift'ni muntazam avtomatik aniqlash, serverni tuzatish o'rniga almashtirish (immutable).

**Muammo (real vaziyat):** "app-1 ishlaydi, app-2 yo'q" — kimdir yarim yil oldin app-1'da `sysctl`ni qo'lda o'zgartirgan. Hech kim nega ekanini bilmaydi. Server o'lsa, yangisini bir kunda ham tiklab bo'lmaydi; DR rejasi qog'ozda qoladi.

**Qanday paydo bo'ladi:**
```
kod (git)  ---apply--->  server holati
                            ^
     shoshilinch SSH fix ---+  (kodga qaytmadi)
     paket auto-update  ---+
     kimdir "vaqtincha"  ---+
natija: kod != haqiqat  -> keyingi apply fix'ni qaytaradi yoki kutilmagan narsani buzadi
```

**Amalda (aniqlash):**
```bash
ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff     # o'zgartirmasdan farqni ko'rsatadi
terraform plan -detailed-exitcode            # exit 0 = farq yo'q, 2 = drift bor (CI'da kunlik)
sudo apt install etckeeper                   # /etc'ni git'da kuzatadi
cd /etc && sudo git log -p --since=yesterday # kim/nima o'zgartirdi
debsums -c                                   # paket fayllari o'zgarganmi (Debian)
```

**Oldini olish:**
- Har o'zgarish — PR: review, tarix, rollback imkoniyati.
- Shoshilinch qo'lda tuzatish bo'lsa — o'sha kuni kodga ko'chirish (ticket bilan).
- Drift detection'ni CI'da jadval bilan ishlat va natijani alert qil.
- Pets vs cattle: golden image (Packer) yoki container; buzilgan serverni tuzatma — yangisiga almashtir.
- Prod'ga SSH — istisno (break-glass), audit log bilan; doimiy yozish huquqi yo'q.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ansible'ni faqat yangi server o'rnatishda ishlatish — keyin hech qachon qayta ishga tushirilmaydi va kod eskiradi.
- `--check` rejimi `shell`/`command` task'larini to'g'ri bashorat qila olmaydi — idempotent modullarni ishlat.
- Kodda yo'q narsa (qo'lda qo'yilgan cron) drift sifatida ko'rinmaydi — faqat boshqariladigan resurslar tekshiriladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng ishonchli test — serverni muntazam noldan qayta yaratish. Agar avtomatik yaratilgan server prod'dagisi kabi ishlasa, drift yo'q; ishlamasa — DR ham ishlamaydi.

33146.a:
**0-3 daqiqa — ta'sir:**
- Dashboard: RPS, error rate, p50/p95/p99 — hamma endpoint'lardami yoki bittasida? Bitta host/AZ'dami yoki hammasida?
- Mijozlarga ta'sir bormi? Severity e'lon qil, kanal och.

**3-8 daqiqa — "nima o'zgardi":**
- Oxirgi deploy/config/feature flag/infra o'zgarishi? Trafik o'sishi (marketing, bot)?
- Trace'lar: vaqt qayerga ketyapti — DB so'rovi, tashqi API, lock?

**8-15 daqiqa — mitigation:**
| Topilma | Chora |
|---|---|
| Yangi deploy bilan boshlangan | rollback |
| Bitta host yomon | LB'dan chiqar |
| DB sekin (lock, slow query) | og'ir so'rovni o'ldir, read replica, feature flag bilan og'ir funksiyani o'chir |
| Trafik ortgan | scale out, rate limit |
| Tashqi API sekin | timeout/circuit breaker, degrade |

Host darajasida (agar bitta host): `uptime`, `vmstat 1`, `iostat -x`, `ss -s`, `journalctl -p err --since "-30m"`, `dmesg -T | tail`.
Har qadamni vaqt bilan kanalga yoz. Stabil bo'lgach — postmortem. Interview'da "avval ta'sir va mitigation, keyin root cause" tartibi baholanadi.

33147.a:
```
namei -l /var/www/app/uploads/file.jpg    # har bir katalog ruxsati — x yo'qligini ko'rsatadi
sudo -u www-data test -r /path && echo ok # servis user'i nomidan sinash
ps -o user,group,supgid -p PID            # jarayon haqiqiy guruhlari
id www-data
getfacl /path
findmnt -T /path                          # ro / noexec?
lsattr /path                              # i = immutable
ls -Z /path ; ausearch -m avc -ts recent  # SELinux
systemctl show app -p ProtectSystem,ProtectHome,ReadWritePaths,User
```
Tez-tez uchraydigan holatlar:
- User'ni guruhga qo'shding (`usermod -aG`), lekin servis restart qilinmagan — eski guruhlar bilan ishlayapti.
- `/home/user` 700 — nginx `/home/user/site`ga kira olmaydi (katalog x).
- `ProtectHome=yes` — servis uchun `/home` bo'sh ko'rinadi.
- Port 80 non-root: `AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE`.
- Skript `noexec` mount qilingan `/tmp` dan ishga tushirilmoqda.
